newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-LATE GOAL GIVES SWITZERLAND RENEWED HOPE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE GOAL GIVES SWITZERLAND RENEWED HOPE.

text.p: A late goal by Grasshoppers striker Kubilay Turkyilmaz on his home ground, the Hardturm Stadium, gave Switzerland a deserved 1-0 victory over Hungary in a World Cup qualifying group match on Wednesday.
Only seven minutes remained when a long pass from the Swiss captain Ciriaco Sforza was headed on by Ramon Vega for Turkyilmaz to drive in.
The home team had earlier wasted countless chances by careless shooting, rarely forcing Hungarian goalkeeper Szabolcs Safar to make a save.
Hungary, now joint-second with Switzerland in the group, might even have taken the lead just before half-time, when Ferenc Orosz hit a post.
